name: Feeling Seen
source:
Follow the coming-of-age story of Mona, an average freshman student in college who is crazed by the conspiracy-ridden fantasy that someone or something is watching her. 

Always. 

She could only handle the bullying and harassment of her classmates for so long until her parents removed her from class and enrolled her into online classes. Online college classes are easy, convenient even. But everyone needs a friend to chat with, a shoulder to cry on, and a boy to pine over. 

Lonely, and searching for a solution, Mona finds herself in a mysterious forum chatroom with three people who are experiencing the same paranoia just like hers. 

[From [url=https://nubzywubzy.itch.io/feeling-seen]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一段围绕普通大一女生莫娜展开的成长故事——她深陷阴谋论式的妄想难以自拔，总觉得有什么人或什么东西正在暗中窥视着自己。

无时无刻。

面对同班同学没完没了的霸凌与骚扰，忍耐到极限的她最终被父母办了退班手续，转而修读线上课程。大学网课固然轻松方便，可每个人都需要能谈天说地的朋友、能靠着痛哭的肩膀，以及能让人暗自思慕的男孩。

孤独无助、渴望摆脱现状的莫娜误入了一个神秘的论坛聊天室，在那里结识了三名正经历着同样被害妄想的网友。

[摘自[url=https://nubzywubzy.itch.io/feeling-seen]itch.io[/url]]
